body:
I will never get over this one 🤍

Speak Now is the only album Taylor has ever written completely alone — all 14 standard-edition tracks, no co-writers, no one to split the credit with.

And it didn't just hold up, it broke things: 1,047,000 copies sold in its first week. The first album since Lil Wayne's Tha Carter III to cross a million in a single opening week — and only the fourth time any woman had ever done it, after Britney Spears, Whitney Houston, and Norah Jones. Grammy.com later framed writing it entirely alone as 'a mic drop against critics.'

An album she wrote by herself, outselling everyone who doubted she could. Tag whoever counted her out back then — they know now.
